content.shortDesc: Indian Institute of Management Nagpur invites online applications for Junior Executive - Regular (OBC) with Graduation and 3 years experience; age up to 35 years; last date 10 Oct 2026 5 PM.
content.metaDescription: IIM Nagpur Junior Executive (OBC) 2026: Graduation + 3 years admin experience, age 35 max, regular 7th CPC post in Nagpur; apply online by 10 Oct 2026.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Indian Institute of Management Nagpur is looking for a qualified and experienced Junior Executive (Regular, OBC) for general administrative duties including hostels, canteen, sports complex, health centre, student services, events, proposals, vendor contracts, MIS reports and record-keeping. Apply online only via the Samarth portal by 10/10/2026 up to 5:00 PM.

sections.heading: Eligibility
items: Minimum 3 years post-qualification experience in academic/administrative activities, preferably student affairs
IIM/IIT/NIT or premier institution experience added advantage

sections.heading: Age and terms
items: Not exceeding 35 years as on last date of application
Regular appointment per 7th Pay Commission with 2-year probation
Accommodation per housing policy subject to availability
Institute may transfer roles or engage contractually if no suitable regular candidate

sections.heading: How to apply
items: Read the full IIM Nagpur advertisement on www.iimnagpur.ac.in
Apply online only at the Samarth portal before 10 Oct 2026 5 PM
Only shortlisted candidates informed about interview; rejection mails not sent

faqs.a: 10 Oct 2026 up to 5:00 PM, online only.
Not exceeding 35 years as on the last date.
